title: ExplorerCatalogItems
responsibility: Lays catalog rows in their grid through the shared page/component card, helper cards or category table in list pages and relationship tabs; each card owns its layout.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.category
inputs.description: Required catalog category: pages and components use the shared screenshot card, functions, models and services helper cards, and shells and configs the category table.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.rows
inputs.description: Required revision-scoped rows to render in their supplied order.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.nav
inputs.description: Required entity navigation retaining the selected branch and revision.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.lens
inputs.description: Required evidence lens supplying screenshots for each visual entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required URL prefix used to resolve captured screenshot assets.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.verification
inputs.description: Optional verification visibility, defaulting to true; relationship tabs pass false.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.batch
inputs.description: Optional rows shown per View More step, defaulting to 0 for all rows; relationship tabs pass 4.

inputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name of a batched group and its View More action, defaulting to the category.

outputs.name: ExplorerCatalogItems
outputs.description: One category of revision-scoped catalog items using the same renderer in collections and relationship tabs. Verification is optional without changing item navigation or screenshots.
